label: Cereals Containing Gluten
definition: EU FIC Annex II group 1; covers wheat, rye, barley, oats and their hybridised strains

label: Crustaceans
definition: EU FIC Annex II group 2; US and Canada: crustacean shellfish

label: Fish
definition: EU FIC Annex II group 4; US and Canada require the species

label: Milk
definition: EU FIC Annex II group 7 (including lactose)

label: Tree Nuts
definition: EU FIC Annex II group 8 (almond, hazelnut, walnut, cashew, pecan, Brazil nut, pistachio, macadamia); AU/NZ and US require the individual nut

label: Celery
definition: EU FIC Annex II group 9; not a regulated allergen in AU/NZ, US or Canada

label: Mustard
definition: EU FIC Annex II group 10; also a Canadian priority allergen

label: Sesame
definition: EU FIC Annex II group 11; US ninth major allergen from 1 January 2023

label: Sulphites
aliases: sulfites;sulphur dioxide;sulfur dioxide;sulphur dioxide and sulphites
definition: EU FIC Annex II group 12 (sulphur dioxide and sulphites at more than 10 mg/kg or 10 mg/litre); AU/NZ and Canada thresholds differ

label: Lupin
definition: EU FIC Annex II group 13; also regulated in AU/NZ

label: Molluscs
definition: EU FIC Annex II group 14; Canada lists molluscs; AU/NZ list molluscs; US does not list molluscs federally
